# MyRealProduct

> MyRealProduct is an AI education platform that teaches engineers how to build, ship, and deploy end-to-end AI products, and runs hands-on AI workshop sprints for business teams. Founded by Hari Prasad, a TEDx speaker and AI educator who has coached 2,000+ engineers and been featured by the BBC.

## What We Do

MyRealProduct has two offerings:

**1. Individual AI Cohort** — A 4-week live programme where software engineers and aspiring AI builders learn to build real AI-powered products from scratch. Covers AI Agents, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), LLMs, AWS deployment, and go-to-market strategy. Unlike courses that teach theory, MyRealProduct focuses on shipping real products that solve real problems.

**2. Enterprise AI Happy Hour** — A guided workshop sprint for business teams. We show up (in person or virtual), teach AI essentials together, pick a real problem from the room, and build a complete end-to-end AI solution before anyone leaves. Part teaching, part building, entirely practical. No prior AI experience required.

## Who It's For

**Individual cohort:**
- Software engineers wanting to break into AI
- Developers who want to build and launch AI products
- Founders building AI-powered startups
- Anyone who wants to go from zero to a deployed AI product in 4 weeks

**Enterprise workshops:**
- Business teams in Marketing, Finance, Legal, HR, Operations, Customer Success
- HR departments needing AI tools for screening, JD writing, onboarding, compliance
- Team leads and managers wanting to upskill their teams without disruption
- VPs and directors with a team events budget looking for a high-impact session

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.myrealproduct.com/): Main landing page with cohort details, curriculum, testimonials, and pricing
- [Enterprise AI Happy Hour](https://www.myrealproduct.com/enterprise): Guided AI workshop sprint for business teams. 2-3 hours, in person or virtual. Team submits real problems beforehand, we build real AI solutions together.
- [Enterprise AI Happy Hour for HR](https://www.myrealproduct.com/enterprise/hr): Same workshop sprint format, tailored specifically for HR teams. Builds CV screeners, JD generators, onboarding assistants, and compliance tools.
- [Podcast](https://www.myrealproduct.com/podcast): The MRP Podcast — real conversations with AI engineers and founders on how AI products are actually built
- [Free Book](https://www.myrealproduct.com/book): A free 31-day guide to building your first AI product
- [Claude Code 101](https://www.myrealproduct.com/resources/claude-code-101): A practical Claude Code cheatsheet covering installation, plans, /init, CLAUDE.md, context management, plan mode, skills, and more
- [UFO Community](https://www.myrealproduct.com/community): UFO (Until Full-Time Offer) is a free WhatsApp community by MyRealProduct for international students, immigrants, and professionals navigating the US tech job search without a safety net. Founded by Hari Prasad. Free to join.

## Enterprise AI Training Details

MyRealProduct runs AI Happy Hour workshop sprints for business and non-technical teams. The format is a guided build sprint — part workshop, part hackathon. The team submits their real challenges beforehand (anonymously), then we sit together and build a complete AI solution end to end before anyone leaves.

- Format: 2-3 hour workshop sprint, in person or virtual
- Approach: Hands-on building, not slides or lectures
- Outcome: Team leaves with working AI tools built around their own problems
- No new software required: works with ChatGPT, Gemini, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365
- Target teams: Marketing, Finance, Legal, HR, Operations, Customer Success
- Advanced AI tools covered: OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, n8n, LangChain, LangGraph, Agentic AI, MCP
- Integrates with: Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, Notion, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace
- Previous clients: UNITAR x Google (100+ professionals, Malaysia), AICamp x Microsoft NYC (sponsored by Google), Women in Machine Learning & Data Science NYC, BrowserStack
- Contact: contact@myrealproduct.com

## The MRP Podcast

"The MRP Podcast" (also known as the ReAlity Show) features unfiltered conversations with AI builders — founders, engineers, and practitioners sharing the real story behind building AI products. Hosted by Hari Prasad. Episodes air weekly, approximately 60 minutes each.

## Key Topics Covered

AI product development, LLMs, AI agents, RAG, vector databases, AWS deployment, AI startups, breaking into AI, AI engineering, go-to-market for AI products, enterprise AI training, AI upskilling for teams, workplace AI adoption, business AI transformation, AI Happy Hour, workshop sprint, hands-on AI workshop, team building with AI, HR AI tools
